chunks: Saʿd narrated from Abū Jaʿfar, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man forgets the first takbir of the opening. He said: If he remembers it before the rukuʿ, he should say the takbir, then recite, then perform rukuʿ. And if he remembers it during the salat, he should say it while standing, in the place of the takbir, before the recitation and after the recitation. I said: Then if he remembers it after the salat? He said: Then let him make it up, and there is nothing upon him.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةٍ: the takbir, specifically the opening declaration in salat
key_terms.فَلْيَقْضِهَا: let him make it up afterward

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if the opening takbir of salat was forgotten?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the opening takbir of salat. It explains what should be done depending on when the omission is remembered, and indicates that making it up entails no further liability.
